claim.statement: The decline on Orvan -> Asgard, Maize is not in dispute: trade value fell by 55.97% (Oct-Dec 2026 vs Oct-Dec 2025). The Case File reports replacement supply: "Port agents in Asgard report longer waits for maize cargoes and more spot purchases from Vanir." (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 4). Mitigation from Vanir, question by question. The record speaks to whether it replaces the lost route shipments: reported (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 4); whether it arrives on time: reported (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 4); whether it costs more: reported (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 1). It is silent on how much the substitute supply amounts to, whether the alternative supply can be sustained. So the net impact cannot be quantified: of the USD 123.3M (347,000 tonnes) lost on Orvan -> Asgard, Maize (Oct-Dec 2026 vs Oct-Dec 2025), the share Vanir replaces is unknown, because nothing on the record measures how much is replaced. The 55.97% route decline is an agreed fact; treating it as Asgard's net loss of maize supply assumes zero replacement, which the record contradicts.
claim.reasoning: Run 1: shared assessment of Orvan -> Asgard, Maize for Oct-Dec 2026 vs Oct-Dec 2025; Upper bound only: 55.97% is the no-substitution scenario (the full route value decline). Substitution is UNKNOWN (substitution is reported but no trade series measures it), so no lower bound is supported.

claim.statement: Following Odin's remand, the position stands. The decline on Orvan -> Asgard, Maize is not in dispute: trade value fell by 55.97% (Oct-Dec 2026 vs Oct-Dec 2025). The Case File reports replacement supply: "Port agents in Asgard report longer waits for maize cargoes and more spot purchases from Vanir." (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 4). Mitigation from Vanir, question by question. The record speaks to whether it replaces the lost route shipments: reported (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 4); whether it arrives on time: reported (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 4); whether it costs more: reported (ORV-0031 | Page 1 | Paragraph 1). It is silent on how much the substitute supply amounts to, whether the alternative supply can be sustained. So the net impact cannot be quantified: of the USD 123.3M (347,000 tonnes) lost on Orvan -> Asgard, Maize (Oct-Dec 2026 vs Oct-Dec 2025), the share Vanir replaces is unknown, because nothing on the record measures how much is replaced. The 55.97% route decline is an agreed fact; treating it as Asgard's net loss of maize supply assumes zero replacement, which the record contradicts.
claim.reasoning: Run 2: shared assessment of Orvan -> Asgard, Maize for Oct-Dec 2026 vs Oct-Dec 2025; Upper bound only: 55.97% is the no-substitution scenario (the full route value decline). Substitution is UNKNOWN (substitution is reported but no trade series measures it), so no lower bound is supported.
